entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please briefly state the reason for your call.
Uh, hi. I think... I think I need to return something? I'm just a bit lost.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I... I have this VeloBand GPS Tracker and I think I need to send it back. I'm so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. I just need to pull up your account. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes. It's VF789-0115. I got it a few weeks ago, but it's all just a bit much for me.

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, so about 25 days ago. To make sure I'm getting you the right solution, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference, I guess. It's not broken or anything. I just feel overwhelmed. I didn't really understand all the features on the website, and now I'm not sure about the return policy. Can't you just help me? I feel so helpless with this.
Of course, I can help. It's completely understandable to feel that way with new technology. Let me just check the return eligibility for you right now.
Alright, I've just reviewed your order against our system. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.
Really? So it's not too late? I was so worried I had missed the deadline.

No, you're perfectly fine. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent an email to the address on file with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, we'll issue a full refund.
Oh, that's amazing! Thank you so, so much, Alex. You've made this so easy. I was really stressed about it.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could clear that up for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
